sentences.text: Hi Flora,
sentences.translation: 嗨，Flora，

sentences.text: Thanks for your email. To answer your question,
sentences.translation: 谢谢你的邮件。回答你的问题，

sentences.text: my new school is great!
sentences.translation: 我的新学校很棒！

sentences.text: It’s very beautiful.
sentences.translation: 它非常漂亮。

sentences.text: There are many modern buildings.
sentences.translation: 有很多现代化的建筑。

sentences.text: There’s a large sports field next to the teachers’ building.
sentences.translation: 教师楼旁边有一个很大的运动场。

sentences.text: All the students go there and do exercises together in the morning.
sentences.translation: 早上所有学生都去那里一起做操。

sentences.text: It’s amazing! Every Monday we raise the flag there.
sentences.translation: 太棒了！每周一我们都在那里升旗。

sentences.text: It’s a special way to start the week.
sentences.translation: 这是一种特别的开启新一周的方式。

sentences.text: The classroom building is behind the sports field.
sentences.translation: 教学楼在运动场的后面。

sentences.text: We spend most of the time in our classroom.
sentences.translation: 我们大部分时间都在教室里。

sentences.text: It’s big and clean. Every week, we change seats.
sentences.translation: 它又大又干净。每周我们都换座位。

sentences.text: This week I sit next to my best friend, Han Lin.
sentences.translation: 这周我坐在我最好的朋友 Han Lin 旁边。

sentences.text: The dining hall is across from the sports field.
sentences.translation: 食堂在运动场的对面。

sentences.text: It’s my favourite place
sentences.translation: 那是我最喜欢的地方，

sentences.text: because there are many kinds of food.
sentences.translation: 因为那里有很多种食物。

sentences.text: I love the Chinese food there.
sentences.translation: 我喜欢那里的中餐。

sentences.text: They make delicious jiaozi.
sentences.translation: 他们做的饺子很好吃。

sentences.text: How about your school?
sentences.translation: 你的学校怎么样？

sentences.text: Yours,Peter
sentences.translation: 你的朋友，Peter
